page_title: UZB 1-3 COL | Uzbekistan v Colombia 18/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+11' Bekhruz Karimov (Uzbekistan) picks up the ball after it rebounds far from goal. He unleashes a powerful shot in the right direction, but not accurate enough to find the back of the net as it rattles the crossbar!
90+10' Azizbek Amonov (Uzbekistan) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

90+9' 1 - 3 It's a goal! Jaminton Campaz (Colombia) makes it 1:3. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Cucho Hernandez and planted his close-range header into the bottom left corner. Utkir Yusupov was helpless.
90+6' The referee blows his whistle as Daniel Munoz (Colombia) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90+3' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jhon Arias as he is replaced by Kevin Castano (Colombia).
90+3' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Igor Sergeev (Uzbekistan) replacing Eldor Shomurodov.
90+3' Substitution. Luis Diaz walks off the pitch and Andres Gomez (Colombia) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' The ball is crossed into the box and Eldor Shomurodov (Uzbekistan) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the roof of the net, but Camilo Vargas gets a glove on it to thwart him.
90+1' Akmal Mozgovoy (Uzbekistan) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
90+1' The attendance for today's match is 80824.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' The corner by Dostonbek Khamdamov (Uzbekistan) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
88' A nice individual effort by Dostonbek Khamdamov (Uzbekistan) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. Uzbekistan get a corner.
87' Jaminton Campaz (Colombia) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
86' A pass into space is latched onto by Jefferson Lerma (Colombia), and he bends a shot just wide of the left post that had the keeper worried.
86' There's an opportunity for Jhon Arias (Colombia) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

85' Jaminton Campaz (Colombia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Colombia have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Richard Rios (Colombia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Anthony Taylor no option but to blow his whistle.
82' Johan Mojica (Colombia) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
81' Eldor Shomurodov (Uzbekistan) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
80' A substitution has been made. Gustavo Puerta goes off and Richard Rios (Colombia) comes on.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cucho Hernandez (Colombia) comes onto the pitch so that Luis Suarez can be given a rest.
79' Dangerous play by Abdulla Abdullaev (Uzbekistan). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Rustam Ashurmatov (Uzbekistan) is being substituted because of an injury. Fabio Cannavaro sends Jakhongir Urozov on the pitch.
77' It will be a substitution. Azizbek Amonov (Uzbekistan) is ready to enter the pitch as Abbosbek Fayzullaev walks off.
76' Rustam Ashurmatov (Uzbekistan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
76' Jhon Arias (Colombia) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
75' Abdukodir Khusanov (Uzbekistan) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
74' Flag goes up against Luis Diaz (Colombia) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jaminton Campaz (Colombia) comes onto the pitch for James Rodriguez.
69' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
68' Daniel Munoz (Colombia) is first to arrive to a high rebound just outside the box and attempts to score with a header, but the keeper blocks it.
65' 1 - 2 Goal Luis Diaz (Colombia)! Luis Diaz (Colombia) was put through by Gustavo Puerta and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 1:2.
64' James Rodriguez (Colombia) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

64' Jefferson Lerma (Colombia) picks up a rebound in space and tries his luck from long range, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Colombia manage to earn a corner.
64' Jhon Arias (Colombia) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
62' Gustavo Puerta (Colombia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
60' 1 - 1 Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.

60' This was a nice effort by both teams. Eldor Shomurodov (Uzbekistan) connected with a cross from the side and slammed it straight towards the bottom right corner. Camilo Vargas leapt like a salmon and tipped the ball onto the post.
57' Abdulla Abdullaev (Uzbekistan) was too forceful with his tackle and Anthony Taylor interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
55' The current number of corner kicks is 2:2.
52' Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Anthony Taylor stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
50' Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
49' Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Uzbekistan are awarded a corner kick.
48' Jhon Arias (Colombia) jumps into a tackle and Anthony Taylor signals a foul.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Sherzod Nasrullaev (Uzbekistan) is replaced by Farrukh Sayfiev.
46' Fabio Cannavaro has made a change at the break. Dostonbek Khamdamov has come on in place of Oston Urunov (Uzbekistan).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Gustavo Puerta (Colombia) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
45+4' Jhon Arias (Colombia) sends the corner into the box, but Utkir Yusupov intercepts it and averts the threat.

45+4' Luis Diaz (Colombia) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Colombia.
45+2' The resulting corner from Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) is cleared.
45+1' Luis Suarez (Colombia) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' James Rodriguez (Colombia) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Utkir Yusupov was alert and made a comfortable save.
40' 0 - 1 Goal! Luis Diaz puts a cross into the box and finds Daniel Munoz (Colombia), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the roof of the net. He makes it 0:1.
40' James Rodriguez (Colombia) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
38' Jhon Lucumi (Colombia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Jefferson Lerma (Colombia) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
35' James Rodriguez (Colombia) will take the free kick.
34' Yellow card. Abdukodir Khusanov (Uzbekistan) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
32' Post! Luis Diaz (Colombia) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
30' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sherzod Nasrullaev (Uzbekistan).
29' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle as Gustavo Puerta (Colombia) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
28' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Eldor Shomurodov (Uzbekistan).
26' The ball possession is 30:70.
23' The referee blows for a cooling break.
23' The foul by Bekhruz Karimov (Uzbekistan) was seen by Anthony Taylor who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
22' Gustavo Puerta (Colombia) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
21' Some neat passing and movement from Colombia as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
19' Jefferson Lerma (Colombia) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
18' Colombia force a corner. They send men into the box.
18' Daniel Munoz (Colombia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' That was close by Jhon Arias (Colombia)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
17' Utkir Yusupov (Uzbekistan) is able to continue to play.
15' Utkir Yusupov (Uzbekistan) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
15' Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
14' Rough tackle by Eldor Shomurodov (Uzbekistan). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Daniel Munoz (Colombia) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
11' Anthony Taylor blows for a foul after Abdulla Abdullaev (Uzbekistan) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
7' What was Johan Mojica (Colombia) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

5' James Rodriguez (Colombia) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
4' Anthony Taylor couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Abdukodir Khusanov (Uzbekistan) and blew his whistle.
2' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
1' Jhon Lucumi (Colombia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Colombia will kick-off.
Anthony Taylor got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
